parts.q: Aziza: What about going to the new café? Malika: I quite ______ going there, let's go.
parts.explain: Bu ibora «I quite fancy ...» yoqtirishni bildiradi. «let's go» so'zlari bu yerda o'rinli ekanini ko'rsatadi.

wrong.hate: Salbiy ma'noni bildiradi, ammo keyingi «let's go» ijobiy javobni talab qiladi.
wrong.mind: Bu fe'l bu yerda yordamchi ma'noda ishlatilmaydi.

parts.q: Jasur: Shall we watch a horror film? Timurbek: I don't really ______ watching scary movies at night.
parts.explain: Bu ibora «I don't really fancy ...» yoqtirmaslikni bildiradi. «scary movies at night» bu yerda salbiy munosabatni talab qiladi.

wrong.like: Bu holatda grammatik jihatdan mos kelmaydi.
wrong.want: «don't really want» ma'nosi mos kelgani bilan, berilgan funksional iboraga kirmaydi.

parts.q: Madina: Have you heard the new album by Jamik? Nigina: Yes, I'm a big ______ of his music!
parts.explain: Bu ibora «I'm a big fan of ...» kuchli qiziqishni bildiradi. «his music» bu yerda uning ashaddiy muxlisi ekanini ko'rsatadi.

wrong.lover: Ma'nosi to'g'ri bo'lsa ham, berilgan bazadagi iboraga kirmaydi.
wrong.follower: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlar uchun ishlatiladi, bu iboraga mos kelmaydi.

parts.q: Bekzod: Do you want to play football in this heat? Sardor: No, I'm not a big ______ of playing sports when it's hot.
parts.phrase: I'm not a big fan of ...
parts.explain: Bu ibora «I'm not a big fan of ...» unchalik yoqtirmaslikni bildiradi. «in this heat» rad etishni ko'rsatadi.

wrong.supporter: Sport jamoalariga nisbatan ishlatiladi, bu yerda ma'nosi mos emas.

parts.q: Zebo: Are you going to join the art club? Dilnoza: Yes, I'm ______ on painting and drawing.
parts.explain: Bu ibora «I'm keen on ...» biror narsaga qiziqishni bildiradi. «painting and drawing» bu yerda ijobiy tanlovni talab qiladi.

wrong.interested: «interested in» bo'lishi kerak, shuning uchun bu yerda xato.
wrong.fond: «fond of» ishlatiladi, bu yerda «on» so'zi turibdi.

parts.q: Otabek: Let's read this physics book together. Sanjar: Sorry, I'm not ______ on heavy textbooks.
parts.explain: Bu ibora «I'm not keen on ...» yoqtirmaslikni bildiradi. «Sorry» so'zi rad etishni ko'rsatib turibdi.

parts.q: Sevara: What do you think of traditional Uzbek pilaf? Kamola: I ______ it, I could eat it every day!
parts.explain: Bu ibora «I adore ...» juda yaxshi ko'rishni bildiradi. «I could eat it every day» iborasi buni tasdiqlaydi.

wrong.hate: Salbiy ma'no bildiradi, lekin keyingi jumla ijobiy.

parts.q: Shaxzod: Should we walk home or take a bus? Farhod: I'd ______ walk, the weather is nice.
parts.explain: Bu ibora «I'd rather ...» afzal ko'rishni bildiradi. «the weather is nice» piyoda yurish yaxshiroq ekanini ko'rsatadi.

wrong.prefer: «I'd prefer to» bo'lishi kerak edi, bu yerda to yo'q.
wrong.better: Grammatik jihatdan bu yerga to'g'ri kelmaydi.

parts.q: Akmal: Which film should we choose for tonight? Shavkat: I think the comedy will be ______ or more fun.
parts.phrase: I'm think ... will be better / more fun.
parts.explain: Bu ibora «I think ... will be better / more fun» fikr bildirish uchun ishlatiladi. «more fun» so'zi bilan birga keladi.

wrong.best: Qiyosiy daraja emas, orttirma daraja ishlatilmayapti.
wrong.good: Ijobiy ma'noda bo'lsa ham, bu yerga qiyosiy daraja kerak.

parts.q: Munisa: Let's do our homework at the library. Nozima: Shall we settle ______ that?
parts.explain: Bu ibora «Shall we settle on ...?» kelishuvga erishish uchun taklif bildiradi. «on» predlogi talab qilinadi.

parts.q: Jasur: Let's meet at 5 p.m. by the park. Timur: OK, I ______.
parts.explain: Bu ibora «OK, I agree» rozilik bildirish uchun ishlatiladi. «OK» so'zidan keyin keladi.

wrong.accept: Bu fe'l yolg'iz o'zi bu kontekstda ishlatilmaydi.
wrong.approve: Ma'nosi boshqacharoq, bu yerda rozilik bildirish fe'li kerak.

parts.q: Noila: I brought some fresh apples from our garden. Malika: That's a great ______.
parts.explain: Bu ibora «That's a great idea» yaxshi taklifni ma'qullash uchun ishlatiladi. «great» so'zidan keyin keladi.

wrong.plan: Ma'nosi yaqin bo'lsa ham, iboradagi so'z boshqa.

parts.q: Alisher: Do you like playing computer games? Jamshid: I quite ______ playing strategy games with my friends.
parts.explain: Bu ibora «I quite fancy ...» yoqtirishni bildiradi. «playing» gerundiy shakli bilan keladi.

wrong.enjoy: Garchi ma'nosi bir xil bo'lsa ham, bu iboraga kirmaydi.

parts.q: Komila: Do you want to go to the mountains this weekend? Umid: I don't really ______ walking long distances in the cold.
parts.explain: Bu ibora «I don't really fancy ...» xohlamaslikni bildiradi. Salbiy fikrni bildirish uchun ishlatiladi.

wrong.want: Grammatik jihatdan to'g'ri kelgani bilan, kerakli ibora emas.
wrong.wish: Tilak bildirishda ishlatiladi, bu yerga noto'g'ri.

parts.q: Farangiz: Do you like reading sci-fi books? Diyor: Yes, I'm a big ______ of science fiction novels!
parts.explain: Bu ibora «I'm a big fan of ...» muxlis ekanini bildiradi. «science fiction novels» bu yerda obyektdir.

wrong.admirer: Ma'nosi biroz boshqacha, odatda odamlarga nisbatan ishlatiladi.

parts.q: Sardor: Shall we eat fast food today? Bobur: No, I'm not a big ______ of burgers and chips.
parts.phrase: I'm not a big fan of ...
parts.explain: Bu ibora «I'm not a big fan of ...» yoqtirmaslikni bildiradi. «burgers and chips» ga nisbatan qo'llanilgan.

parts.q: Aziz: Do you want to play tennis or chess? Otabek: I'd ______ to play chess because it's quiet.
parts.explain: Bu ibora «I'd prefer (to) ...» afzal ko'rishni bildiradi. «to play» fe'li ishlatilyapti.

wrong.want: Ma'nosi o'xshash bo'lsa ham, kerakli ibora emas.

parts.q: Azamat: Do you want to take the bus to Samarkand? Lola: No, I ______ sitting in traffic for hours!
parts.explain: Ushbu gapda «I can't stand ...» iborasi qo'llangan, bu «chiday olmayman» degan ma'noni anglatadi va Lola tiqilinchda o'tirishni yomon ko'rishini bildiradi.

wrong.don't mind: «don't mind» (qarshi emasman) mazmunga to'g'ri kelmaydi, chunki Lola «No» degan.
wrong.would prefer: «would prefer» dan so'ng «to» ishlatilishi kerak va ma'nosi to'g'ri kelmaydi.

parts.q: Nodir: Should we watch a movie at home or go to the cinema? Laylo: I think going to the cinema will be ______ or more fun.
parts.phrase: I think ... will be better / more fun.
parts.explain: Ushbu ibora «I think ... will be better / more fun» bo'lib, «yaxshiroq yoki qiziqroq bo'ladi» degan ma'noni anglatadi.

wrong.best: «best» ortirma daraja bo'lib, bu iboraga grammatik jihatdan mos kelmaydi.

parts.q: Rustam: So we will meet outside the museum at 10 a.m.? Anora: That's ______, then. See you tomorrow!
parts.explain: Kelishuvni tasdiqlash uchun «That's agreed, then» («Demak, kelishdik») iborasi ishlatiladi.

wrong.agrees: Bu yerda fe'lning hozirgi zamon shakli «agrees» iborani buzadi.

parts.q:
Sherzod: Do you want to go to the swimming pool after school?
Dildora: Yes, I quite ______ going for a swim today.
parts.explain: «I quite fancy ...» birikmasi biror narsa qilishni xohlashni bildiradi, «going for a swim» jumlasi buni ko'rsatadi.

parts.q:
Davron: How about buying some spicy chips?
Nilufar: No thanks, I don't really ______ eating spicy food.
parts.explain: «I don't really fancy ...» birikmasi «spicy food» yeyishni unchalik xohlamaslikni anglatadi.

parts.q:
Bekzod: Are you going to the concert of Shahzoda tonight?
Madina: Absolutely! I'm a big ______ of her pop music.
parts.explain: «I'm a big fan of ...» iborasi muayyan xonandaning ashaddiy ishqibozi ekanlikni ko'rsatadi.

parts.q:
Javohir: Let's play video games all evening.
Sardor: Sorry, I'm not a big ______ of playing games for hours.
parts.phrase: I'm not a big fan of ...
parts.explain: «I'm not a big fan of ...» birikmasi «playing games» mashg'ulotining ishqibozi emaslikni bildiradi.

parts.q:
Shohruh: Do you want to join our photography club?
Zuhra: Yes, I'm very ______ on taking pictures of nature.
parts.explain: «I'm keen on ...» iborasi «taking pictures» bilan shug'ullanishga qiziqishni bildiradi.

parts.q:
Rustam: Would you like to go ice skating with us?
Nigora: No, I'm not ______ on winter sports at all.
parts.explain: «I'm not keen on ...» iborasi «winter sports» turiga qiziqmaslikni anglatadi.

parts.q:
Umid: Do you want to stay in the classroom during break?
Sabina: No, I can't ______ noisy classrooms, let me go outside.
parts.explain: «I can't stand ...» iborasi «noisy classrooms» muhitiga umuman chiday olmaslikni bildiradi.

parts.q:
Botir: Should we order pizza or pasta for lunch?
Ziyoda: I'd ______ order pizza, it is much faster.
parts.explain: «I'd rather ...» birikmasi pitssani pastadan afzal ko'rishni ifodalaydi.

parts.q:
Khurshid: Do you want to ride a bike or take a taxi?
Dilshod: I'd ______ to ride a bike because of the fresh air.
parts.explain: «I'd prefer (to) ...» iborasi velosipedda yurishni afzal ko'rishni bildiradi.

parts.q:
Sanjar: We can watch the documentary or the comedy film.
Lola: I think the comedy film will be ______ than the documentary.
parts.phrase: I think ... will be better / more fun.
parts.explain: «will be better» birikmasi komediya filmi hujjatli filmdan yaxshiroq bo'lishini bildiradi.

parts.q:
Mansur: We should meet early in the morning to avoid heat.
Nargiza: OK, I ______. Let's meet at 8 a.m.
parts.explain: «OK, I agree.» birikmasi taklif qilingan vaqtga rozi bo'lishni ko'rsatadi.

parts.q:
Firuza: So, we are buying the tickets online tonight, right?
Shahzod: That's ______, then. I will buy them at 7 p.m.
parts.explain: «That's agreed, then.» iborasi chipta sotib olish boyicha kelishib olinganini bildiradi.

parts.q:
Vali: Let me invite our whole group to the picnic on Saturday.
Sami: That's a great ______! Everyone will be happy.
parts.explain: «That's a great idea.» birikmasi ajoyib taklifni qo'llab-quvvatlash uchun ishlatiladi.

parts.q:
Asilbek: Which track do you want to listen to first?
Malika: I quite ______ listening to the acoustic song.
parts.explain: «I quite fancy ...» birikmasi «acoustic song» eshitish istagini bildiradi.

parts.q:
Doniyor: Do you want to go to the rock festival?
Sohiba: Honestly, I'm not a big ______ of rock music.
parts.phrase: I'm not a big fan of ...
parts.explain: «I'm not a big fan of ...» birikmasi «rock music» ishqibozi emaslikni bildiradi.

parts.q: Look at this picture of my cousin playing football in the rain. He looks so tired and wet! Personally, I can't ______ playing sports in bad weather.
parts.explain: Ushbu gapda «I can't stand ...» (yomon ko'raman / chiday olmayman) iborasi qo'llangan. «bad weather» kelgani uchun shu birikma mos keladi.

wrong.stay: «Stay» fe'li «can't stand» iborasi o'rnida ishlatilmaydi va ma'noga to'g'ri kelmaydi.
wrong.stop: «Stop» bu yerda yoqtirmaslik ma'nosini beruvchi iborani hosil qilmaydi.

parts.q: My family is planning our summer trip to Charvak lake. My brother wants to sleep in a tent, but I'd ______ stay in a comfortable hotel.
parts.explain: Bu gap afzallik bildirish uchun «I'd rather ...» (ma'qul ko'rardim) iborasidan foydalanadi. «stay» fe'li to'g'ridan-to'g'ri to-siz kelgani uchun «rather» mos keladi.

wrong.prefer: «Prefer» fe'lidan keyin «to stay» bo'lishi kerak edi.
wrong.better: «I'd better» maslahat berishda qo'llanadi, afzallik bildirishda emas.

parts.q: My sister bought a couple of kittens yesterday. They are so tiny and fluffy that I ______ them already!
parts.explain: Juda yoqtirish va mehr qo'yishni bildirish uchun «I adore ...» (juda yaxshi ko'raman) iborasi ishlatiladi. «tiny and fluffy» iborasi buni tasdiqlaydi.

wrong.enjoy: «Enjoy» odatda jarayondan rohatlanish uchun ishlatiladi, hayvonlarga nisbatan «adore» mosroq.

parts.q: Jasur wants us to hike up the hill this Sunday morning. I don't really ______ waking up at 6 a.m. on my day off.
parts.explain: Xohlamaslikni va yoqtirmaslikni muloyim aytish uchun «I don't really fancy ...» (unchalik xohlamayman) iborasi qo'llanadi. «waking up early» buni ko'rsatadi.

wrong.want: «I don't really want» deyish mumkin, lekin berilgan iboradagi gerund «waking» bilan «fancy» mos keladi.
wrong.wish: «Wish» bu yerda grammatik va strukturaviy jihatdan noto'g'ri.

parts.q: Look at these photos from our trip to Bukhara. I think travelling by train will be ______ than taking a hot minibus.
parts.phrase: I think ... will be better / more fun.
parts.explain: Afzallikni solishtirib aytishda «I think ... will be better» (yaxshiroq bo'ladi deb o'ylayman) iborasi ishlatiladi. Gapdagi «than» buni ko'rsatadi.

parts.q: My friend invited me to a chess tournament after classes. To be honest, I'm not very ______ on playing board games.
parts.explain: Qiziqmaslikni bildirish uchun «I'm not keen on ...» (ishqibozi emasman / qiziqmayman) iborasi qo'llanadi. Keyin kelgan «on» predlogi buni belgilaydi.

parts.q: Look at this old photo of my grandfather playing the rubab. I'm a big ______ of traditional Uzbek music.
parts.explain: Musiqa yoki san'at turining muhlisi ekanlikni bildirishda «I'm a big fan of ...» (ashaddiy muhlisi) iborasi ishlatiladi.

wrong.group: «Big group of» iborasi insonning qiziqishini ifodalamaydi.
wrong.member: «Member» a'zo degani, bu yerda musiqa muhlisligi haqida gap ketmoqda.

parts.q: Nodira wants to meet at the park entrance at 4 p.m. OK, I ______. That gives us plenty of time.
parts.explain: Taklifga rozilik bildirish uchun «OK, I agree» (Mayli, roziman) iborasi ishlatiladi. «That gives us time» bu fikrni tasdiqlaydi.

wrong.accept: «I accept» taklifni qabul qilishda yakka holda bunday ibora bo'lib kelmaydi.
wrong.allow: «I allow» ruxsat berishni bildiradi, kelishuvni emas.

parts.q: So we are going to prepare the presentation together tomorrow after school. That's ______, then. See you in the library!
parts.explain: Suhbat oxirida qarorni yakunlash va kelishish uchun «That's agreed, then» (Kelishdik unda) iborasi ishlatiladi.

wrong.done: «That's done» ish bajarib bo'linganini bildiradi, kelishuv iborasi emas.
wrong.fixed: «That's fixed» so'zlashuv iboralarida kelishuv uchun barqaror funktsional fraza emas.

parts.q: Look at this selfie of my class at the amusement park. I think taking the roller coaster will be more ______ than the Ferris wheel.
parts.phrase: I think ... will be better / more fun.
parts.explain: Biror faoliyatning qiziqroq bo'lishini taqqoslash uchun «will be more fun» (qiziqroq bo'ladi) iborasi ishlatiladi.

parts.q: My uncle invited us to visit his farm in Fergana. I'm really ______ on feeding the horses and riding them.
parts.explain: Biror mashg'ulotga qiziqishni bildirish uchun «I'm keen on ...» (juda qiziqaman / ishqiboziman) iborasi ishlatiladi. «on» predlogi buni tasdiqlaydi.

wrong.happy: «Happy on» iborasi bu grammatik tuzilmaga to'g'ri kelmaydi.

parts.q: Look at this drawing of a cartoon character made by my little sister. I ______ her talent for drawing!
parts.explain: Birovlarning qobiliyatiga qoyil qolish va yoqtirishni ifodalashda «I adore ...» (juda yaxshi ko'raman / tan beraman) iborasi qo'llanadi.

wrong.fancy: «Fancy» fe'li inson qobiliyatiga nisbatan baho berganda «adore»chalik mos emas.
wrong.stand: «Stand» bu kontekstda «can't stand» bo'lmasa ma'no bermaydi.

parts.q: We have two options: watch an action movie or read a comic book. I'd ______ watch the movie.
parts.explain: Ikki narsadan birini afzal ko'rganda va fe'l to-siz kelganda «I'd rather ...» (ma'qul ko'rardim) iborasi ishlatiladi.

wrong.better: «I'd better» maslahat berishda ishlatiladi, afzallik bildirishda emas.

parts.q: Our class wanted to go somewhere on Saturday. Some people wanted the zoo, others wanted the cinema. In the end we said: “Shall we ______ on the cinema?” and everybody agreed.
parts.explain: «Shall we settle on ...?» — «...ga kelishib olamizmi?». Bahsdan keyin bitta variantni tanlashni taklif qilganda aytiladi; «settle» faqat «on» bilan shu ma'noni beradi.

wrong.decide: «decide on» ham mavjud, lekin Functions Bank iborasi aynan «settle on»; «Shall we decide on» kelishuvga erishish iborasi sifatida o'rganilmagan.
wrong.stay: «stay on» — «qolmoq, davom etmoq», kelishish ma'nosini bermaydi.

parts.q: Bobur's message: “I'd ______ stay at home tonight than go to the party. I'm really tired after football.”
parts.explain: «I'd rather ... than ...» — «...dan ko'ra ...ni afzal ko'raman». Undan keyin fe'l «to»siz keladi (stay), gapda «than» ham bor.

wrong.prefer: «I'd prefer» dan keyin «to stay» bo'lishi kerak edi; bu yerda «to» yo'q.

topics.name: Expressing likes and dislikes
topics.summary: Bu iboralar narsalarga, mashg'ulotlarga yoki odamlarga bo'lgan shaxsiy munosabatimizni bildirish uchun ishlatiladi.

usage.text: I quite fancy — «... yoqadi, xohishim bor». Nimadir qilishni yoqtirganimizda ishlatiladi.

example.en: I quite fancy going to the cinema tonight.
example.uz: Bugun kechqurun kinoga borishni xohlayman.

usage.text: I don't really fancy — «... unchalik xohlamayapman». Biror ishni qilishga uncha ishqiboz bo'lmaganda deyiladi.

example.en: I don't really fancy doing homework right now.
example.uz: Hozir uy vazifasini qilishni uncha xohlamayapman.

usage.text: I'm a big fan of — «... ning ashaddiy muxlisiman». Biror narsani juda qattiq yoqtirganda ishlatiladi.

example.en: I'm a big fan of Marvel movies.
example.uz: Men Marvel kinolarining ashaddiy muxlisiman.

usage.text: I'm not a big fan of — «... unchalik yoqmaydi». Biror narsaning muxlisi emasligimizni ko'rsatadi.

example.en: I'm not a big fan of spicy food.
example.uz: Men achchiq ovqatlarning ashaddiy muxlisi emasman.

usage.text: I'm keen on — «... ga qiziqaman». Biror narsa bilan shug'ullanishni yoqtirganda aytiladi.

example.en: I'm keen on playing football after school.
example.uz: Maktabdan keyin futbol o'ynashga qiziqaman.

usage.text: I'm not keen on — «... unchalik qiziqtirmaydi». Biror narsaga ishqiboz emasligimizni bildiradi.

example.en: I'm not keen on getting up early.
example.uz: Erta turishni unchalik yoqtirmayman.

usage.text: I adore — «... ni juda yaxshi ko'raman/pajurman». Kuchli mehr yoki muhabbatni bildiradi.

example.en: I adore spending time with my friends.
example.uz: Do'stlarim bilan vaqt o'tkazishni juda yaxshi ko'raman.

usage.text: I can't stand — «... ga chiday olmayman». Biror narsani butunlay yomon ko'rganda ishlatiladi.

example.en: I can't stand waiting in long queues.
example.uz: Uzun navbatlarda kutishga chiday olmayman.

structure.formula: I adore / I'm keen on + noun / V-ing

example.en: I'm keen on learning English.
example.uz: Ingliz tilini o'rganishga qiziqaman.

structure.formula: I can't stand / I don't fancy + noun / V-ing

example.en: I can't stand listening to loud music.
example.uz: Baland musiqani tinglashga chiday olmayman.

structure.formula: I'm a big fan of + noun / pronoun

example.en: I'm a big fan of this singer.
example.uz: Men bu xonandaning ashaddiy muxlisiman.

topics.tip: «I can't stand» va «I adore» so'zlaridan keyin fe'l kelsa, unga -ing qo'shimchasi qo'shilishini unutmang.

topics.name: Expressing a preference
topics.summary: Biror narsani boshqasidan ustun qo'yganimizda yoki yaxshiroq deb hisoblaganimizda ishlatiladi.

usage.text: I'd rather — «Afzal ko'raman». Biror ishni boshqasidan ko'ra ko'proq qilishni xohlaganda ishlatiladi.

example.en: I'd rather stay at home today.
example.uz: Bugun uyda qolishni afzal ko'rardim.

usage.text: I'd prefer (to) — «... ni afzal ko'raman». Tanlov qilishda qo'llaniladi.

example.en: I'd prefer to drink tea instead of coffee.
example.uz: Qahva o'rniga choy ichishni afzal ko'raman.

usage.text: I think ... will be better / more fun — «... yaxshiroq / qiziqarliroq bo'ladi deb o'ylayman». Fikr bildirganda ishlatiladi.

example.en: I think going to the park will be more fun.
example.uz: Bog'ga borish qiziqarliroq bo'ladi deb o'ylayman.

example.en: I'd rather go by bus.
example.uz: Avtobusda borishni afzal ko'rardim.

example.en: I'd prefer to walk there.
example.uz: U yerga piyoda borishni afzal ko'raman.

structure.formula: I think + clause + will be better

example.en: I think this film will be better.
example.uz: Bu kino yaxshiroq bo'ladi deb o'ylayman.

topics.tip: «I'd rather» dan keyin fe'l «to» qo'shimchasisiz keladi, lekin «I'd prefer» dan keyin «to» ishlatiladi.

topics.name: Reaching an agreement
topics.summary: Biror qarorga kelish yoki suhbatdoshning fikriga qo'shilish paytida ishlatiladigan iboralar.

usage.text: Shall we settle on ...? — «... ga to'xtalsak qanday bo'ladi?». Umumiy qaror qabul qilishda taklif sifatida aytiladi.

example.en: Shall we settle on pizza for dinner?
example.uz: Kechki ovqatga pitsa tanlasak qanday bo'ladi?

usage.text: OK, I agree. — «Xo'p, roziyman». Fikrga qo'shilishni bildiradi.

example.en: OK, I agree, let's watch this comedy.
example.uz: Xo'p, roziyman, keling bu komediyani ko'ramiz.

usage.text: That's agreed, then. — «Kelishdik, unda». Qaror tasdiqlanganda ishlatiladi.

example.en: That's agreed, then. We meet at 5 PM.
example.uz: Kelishdik, unda. Soat 5 da uchrashamiz.

usage.text: That's a great idea. — «Bu zo'r fikr!». Taklif juda yoqqanda bildiriladi.

example.en: That's a great idea, I'd love to go!
example.uz: Bu zo'r fikr, borishni juda xohlayman!

structure.formula: Shall we settle on + noun / V-ing?

example.en: Shall we settle on buying this phone?
example.uz: Bu telefonni sotib olishga to'xtalsak qanday bo'ladi?

example.en: OK, I agree with your plan.
example.uz: Xo'p, seni rejangga roziyman.

example.en: That's a great idea, let's do it.
example.uz: Bu zo'r fikr, keling buni qilamiz.

topics.tip: «Shall we settle on» iborasidan keyin ot yoki -ing qo'shimchali fe'l kelishini yodda saqlang.

mistakes.why: «Keen» so'zi doimo «on» predlogi bilan ishlatiladi, «in» bilan emas.
«Can't stand» iborasidan keyin fe'lga -ing qo'shiladi, «to» bilan kelmaydi.
«I'd rather» dan keyin «to» ishlatilmaydi, faqat fe'lning o'zi keladi.

mistakes.right: I'd prefer to go by train.
mistakes.why: «I'd prefer» o'zidan keyin «to» oladi, shuning uchun «to go» bo'lishi kerak.

mistakes.wrong: I'm a big fan on football.
mistakes.right: I'm a big fan of football.
mistakes.why: «A big fan» iborasidan keyin «of» predlogi ishlatiladi.

mistakes.wrong: Shall we settle in this plan?
mistakes.right: Shall we settle on this plan?
mistakes.why: «Settle on» biror qaror yoki rejaga to'xtalish ma'nosini bildiradi, shuning uchun «on» ishlatiladi.
